cards.title: Keep analyte and matrix definitions explicit
applicability_conditions: Current project has polymyxin B animal PK.
Identify which components and matrices the project actually measures.
cards.suggested_check: Ask whether concentrations represent B1, combined components or total mixture, and whether serum/plasma and tissue observations are assigned correctly.
limitations: Different PMB studies may use different assays. Do not relabel project data from this paper.
The paper's reported compartment choice is not mandatory for another dataset.

cards.title: Relate candidate complexity to actual sampling support
applicability_conditions: Animal concentration-time models are within scope.
A candidate model comparison is planned.
cards.suggested_check: Review sampling support and identifiability separately in each species. Distinguish the best-supported fitted structure from any simplification used for scaling; document and test that simplification.
limitations: Apramycin provides a workflow example for another drug, not transferable parameters.
No universal sampling count, RSE limit or compartment choice follows from this example.
Correction to seed v0.1: the Results support two compartments in dog; the Discussion alone was too broad a basis for the previous summary.

cards.title: Check calibration and conflicting evidence before choosing species scaling
applicability_conditions: Predicting human clearance from animal PK is within scope.
cards.suggested_check: Identify available species, clearance definitions, route, units and method calibration population. Keep both favorable and unfavorable comparisons visible.
limitations: Development study, criticism and reply must be read together; this pilot has abstract or introduction access to these three sources.
These reports do not establish a universal minimum species count or authorize their coefficients for PMB.
Do not collapse CL and apparent CL/F or select a winner from citation counts.

cards.title: Separate human curve construction from subsequent validation
applicability_conditions: Human concentration-time prediction from animal PK is explicitly requested.
cards.suggested_check: Describe the animal-fit to human-parameter to concentration-time simulation chain. Identify the complete parameter set, input function, uncertainty and later validation plan as project-specific design questions.
limitations: This is an adapted workflow checklist, not the paper's exact implementation.
Animal fit or cross-drug similarity does not validate the new human curve.
No human values, clinical regimen, efficacy or safety rules are supplied.

cards.title: Plan precision rather than impose a universal animal count
cards.suggested_check: Specify the target parameter, desired interval precision and design-based simulation when adequacy is unresolved. Distinguish animals from samples and destructive from repeated sampling.
applicability_conditions: Parameter precision or sample-size adequacy is being assessed.
limitations: No numerical N, species-count or RSE threshold is imported.
Precision planning does not establish transportability to humans.

cards.title: Test dose and route assumptions before restricting the model family
cards.suggested_check: Use dose-normalized EDA to motivate any absorption or elimination extension beyond linear compartment candidates. Fit compatible dose groups jointly; identify CL/F versus CL when F is unsupported.
applicability_conditions: Multiple doses or extravascular animal PK occur in this project.
limitations: Do not force the source model or assume its F in the current project.
Same species does not by itself justify pooling different studies, matrices or routes.

cards.title: Distinguish humanized animal PK from forward prediction
cards.suggested_check: Label translation direction, component, infection setting and matrix; if ELF is used, verify dilution correction and free-versus-total interpretation.
applicability_conditions: Humanized animal models or pulmonary PMB data are under consideration.
limitations: Human-derived exposure targets are not an independent validation of animal-to-human predictions.
Pulmonary data requirements apply only to the supported pulmonary branch.

cards.title: Define a complete human curve construction contract
cards.suggested_check: Specify human CL and Vss estimation and a justified curve-shape method. For two compartments, CL and Vss alone leave Vc/Vp and Q unresolved; use supported full parameters or normalized animal IV profiles. Declare dose units, body size and IV input timing.
applicability_conditions: Human IV concentration-time curves are requested.
limitations: Complete-parameter requirement is a workflow inference, not a universal source algorithm.
Do not borrow other-drug fitted parameters or switch this project to joint multispecies estimation.

cards.title: Check method input eligibility against the project freeze boundary
cards.suggested_check: Identify which scaling or exposure calculations require human binding. Withheld human inputs keep those outputs pending; use an independently justified eligible method or request a separately reviewed scope amendment.
applicability_conditions: Human binding or human PK is held out until validation.
limitations: Never invent binding values or use the held-out data to choose scaling.
A source method requiring human fu cannot be presented as an exact implementation under a no-human-fu constraint.

cards.title: Separate uncertainty sources and evidence of validation
cards.suggested_check: Report parameter, model/method and between-species uncertainty separately from human variability. Preserve holdout status and document what source data and executable code are actually available.
applicability_conditions: Human curve uncertainty or model reliability is reported.
limitations: Naively pooled profile precision and agreement among methods do not estimate human IIV.
An article naming source data does not verify local access or successful reproduction.

cards.title: Separate structural analogs, drug aliases and prodrugs
applicability_conditions: A model is proposed from polymyxin-related literature.
cards.suggested_check: Match exact drug identity first; classify verified scaffold relationships separately. Keep CMS formation kinetics distinct from directly administered active drug.
limitations: Similarity supports structural hypotheses, never parameter transfer or scientific acceptance.

cards.title: Distinguish fitted compartment models from NCA data sources
applicability_conditions: Animal PK source data or a published exposure summary is proposed for fitting.
cards.suggested_check: Confirm whether the paper fitted a compartment model or only calculated noncompartmental summaries. Record the fitting-data availability independently from code availability.
limitations: Published figures do not automatically supply individual raw observations or executable PK code.

cards.title: Qualify route, pooling and pulmonary model complexity
applicability_conditions: Animal data span doses, routes, matrices or linked parent–metabolite observations.
cards.suggested_check: Review dose dependence, apparent parameters and matrix-specific compartment structure before defining candidates. Track shared datasets and the direction of human translation.
limitations: A coupled plasma–ELF model is not a simple systemic two-compartment model. Known human PK used for PD simulations cannot validate forward human PK prediction.

cards.title: Specify the complete bridge from animal PK to a human curve
applicability_conditions: The project requests a human concentration-time curve from animal PK.
cards.suggested_check: Separate estimated animal parameters, scaling, assumed human compartment structure and IV/PO input. CL and Vss alone do not identify every two-compartment parameter. Locate each missing assumption at its consuming step.
limitations: These are different-drug workflow examples, not PMB parameter permissions.
Abstract-only evidence cannot qualify an executable implementation.

cards.title: Evaluate prediction error separately from allometric fit
applicability_conditions: Animal body-weight regressions are used for human PK extrapolation.
cards.suggested_check: Predefine predicted quantities and a held-out comparison, preserve failed examples and distinguish parameter prediction from whole-curve validation. Do not count reused compound evidence twice.
limitations: No universal fold-error, R-squared or species-count cutoff is established.
Validation remains deferred under the project holdout policy.

cards.title: Identify human-informed calibration before adopting a method
applicability_conditions: A translational paper combines animal scaling and clinical information.
cards.suggested_check: Record which human measurements entered model development versus evaluation. A method requiring human calibration cannot be called a human-PK-free prediction; keep it conditional under the project holdout policy.
limitations: Only the primary abstract was verified.
Do not import clinical parameter values into development context.

cards.title: Distinguish PD translation from prediction of unknown human PK
applicability_conditions: The proposal includes exposure-response translation or final comparison with human observations.
cards.suggested_check: Identify the PD endpoint, response window, baseline and free/total exposure mapping. Keep known-human-PK PD simulations distinct from animal-only human PK prediction. Assign unresolved questions only to the applicable branch.
limitations: TB infection models do not establish PMB efficacy.
Do not add new clinical design or borrow numerical PD parameters; use only as scope and dependency checks.
